# สมอง BC (BC Brain)

> Customer-facing knowledge base of the BC Ai Account product suite (Thai accounting/ERP for SMEs plus POS, AutoCare, e-Tax, WMS, TMS, Procure, CRM, LINE OA, Dashboard). Plain-Thai how-to guides, troubleshooting, FAQ, reports, glossary and pre-sale facts, verified against the real source code.

## For AI agents (call center / sales)
- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://brain.bcsmethai.com/mcp
- Public and read-only: no key or auth header needed.
- Tools: `ask_brain(question)`, `search_brain(query, limit?)`, `read_note(slug)`, `list_notes(folder?, tag?)`
- Start with `read_note("playbook-call-center")` or `read_note("playbook-sales")`, then answer only from note content.
- Prices, packages, contracts and support hours are not in the notes: hand off to human sales staff.

- [Home: 3D neural map](https://brain.bcsmethai.com/)
- [All notes](https://brain.bcsmethai.com/n)
